title: Psychedelic Projection
caption: Inspired by psychedelic oil projections (liquid light shows).
notes: POSTERIZE filter, get() and image() to create feedback loop

title: Mesmeriser
caption: A mesmerizing pattern generated by rotating and reflecting shapes.

title: Noether
caption: Simulation of elastic collisions between bodies showing the conservation of momentum (linear and angular) and kinetic energy.  The exchange of momentum and energy between the bodies during collisions is visible.  Conservation laws are consequences of Noether's theorem.  Uses a bespoke physics engine.

title: Kaleidoscope 2
caption: A kaleidoscopic pattern generated by reflecting and rotating shapes.

title: Turners
caption: Lines drawn between three rotating points leading to a mandala-like patterns. Complementary colours.  The lines are drawn with a low opacity to create a sense of depth.

title: Qix
caption: Inspired by the 1981 arcade game Qix.  Switch between GPU and CPU rendering modes and see the difference in performance.
notes: DFX library for glow filter, bezierVertex curves
